title: Clo In Paris: User Summit 2024 Highlights
description:
✨ A look back at our 2024 Paris User Summit! ✨

For the second year running, we had an amazing time bringing our users together for an exceptional day. Check out some of the best moments from this memorable event, where creativity and passion really shined. Huge thanks to all our guests for their energy and enthusiasm. Can’t wait to see you next year for an even more inspiring edition!

✨ Retour sur notre conférence d'utilisateurs 2024 à Paris ! ✨

Pour la deuxième année consécutive, nous avons eu le plaisir de réunir nos clients lors d'une journée exceptionnelle. Découvrez les moments forts de cet événement mémorable, où créativité et passion étaient au rendez-vous. Merci à tous nos invités pour leur présence et leur énergie. On se retrouve l'année prochaine pour une nouvelle édition encore plus inspirante !

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord- 

---

Hello, my name is Youssef, I'm a project development and innovation manager at Marroquinerie. I'm Elisabeth Lombaud, I'm responsible for the 3D operational project for the Ochan Retail company. Hello, my name is Philippine and I'm responsible for modeling activities at Pol Underwear. My name is Guy, I'm a 3D modeling teacher at AceMod. I would say a dream, because I would have loved to have this earlier. When I work on clothes, I have fun, so I would say a dream. What I love about this kind of event is that there are brands that come to testify. The tools, they respond exactly to the millimeter. It's great to be around people who, in the end, use it completely differently and it brings us new things. The conviviality, the exchanges, to see that the people I met two years ago continue to move forward. We are on the right track and we just have to keep going. Hey, there's this event I'm running right now. I'm going to step up to see all the developments and updates that have been integrated. Clos has a real advantage, they are much closer to their users, which is great. Lots of activities, the platform, we can see how it's evolving. It's actually a great way to communicate on the same level. And it's really a tool that allows you to respect the creation and help the technician in your everyday life. And what's great about this, in addition, is that these are conversations between the two of you. It's really a tool that allows you to respect the creation and help the technician in your everyday life. between technicians, between fashion geeks. That's really great. This kind of event is really important because there aren't many of us, and to be able to meet like this is really great. It is with great pleasure that I observe the evolution of the collaboration that has been built between you and our Club Paris team. See you very soon. Thank you very much.
